topic.title: DITA Prolog Updater Add-on
topic.shortdesc: The DITA Prolog Updater add-on provides options for updating the prolog section of DITA topics and maps.

body.note:
This add-on is compatible with the following products:
Oxygen XML Editor
Oxygen XML Author
Oxygen XML Developer
body.p: This add-on contributes a preferences page ( Options Preferences Plugins DITA Prolog Updater ) that includes various options for updating the prolog section of a DITA topic or map.
